sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system, Anthropic engineering
usage: `references/migration.md` → one read-only explorer for each role
`references/migration-role-briefs.md` → the bounded brief of each role
`assets/templates/explorer-brief.md`, `assets/templates/producer-brief.md`, `assets/templates/target-brief.md`, `assets/templates/consumer-brief.md` → the required output and the boundary

claims.statement: A brief states an objective, an output format, the sources to read and a clear task boundary, because vague briefs make parallel explorers duplicate each other's work → explorer roles, briefs, Gotchas
A lead agent runs explorers in parallel and scales their number to the question, so the number stays bounded and the lead can read every report → fan-out limits, Essentials
A body attributes a claim with a footnote whose label is a source id, so the attribution survives reordering → evidence, research template

sources.title: Xonovex research conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original procedure of the research step and of migration research: the intent check, the evidence rules, the research file and its write rules, and the producer, target and consumer roles with their report sections and failure modes

claims.statement: The research runs the entry step of recording-handoff first and loads skills from its project settings; a research file is append-only and a correction is a new file that lists the old one in `corrects`; a migration adds no document type and writes a research file with `kind: migration`; observed and inferred facts stay apart; the gap table, the producer changes and the five failure modes are conventions of this workflow.
